_doc: Manifesto do ditador-copia. Os personagens e a folha foram gerados pelos comandos da lista de compras do animatic; o manifesto descreve o que o vídeo usa (o build pula o que já existe) e é ele que carrega o cenário panorâmico do CT duplo.

reacoes.desc: one gloved hand on the chin, eyes looking up and to the side, thinking hard, the other arm folded across the chest still holding the small wooden gavel

cenarios.desc: a very wide football TRAINING GROUND split in two halves by a tall grey concrete wall standing exactly in the middle of the image. RIGHT HALF: the garnet-and-blue club's training pitch, garnet and blue corner flags, garnet training cones on the grass, a low modern training centre building behind. LEFT HALF: the rival all-white club's training pitch, plain white flags, grey cones, a colder white building behind. Both pitches empty, no people at all, bright green grass in the foreground running along the whole width, clear morning sky.
